Lena CSM: Heads-up  NorthStar EBR next Fri 9am PT. Need a 1-slide playbook (flow + 3 bullets) and a live action tracker for post-EBR follow-ups. Draft at ~v0.4 in drive.
Tom SE: I can run the demo. Plan: one canonical path + one tiny offline fallback. Keep demos <=4m.
Grace AM: Can we include a 30s renewal-health snapshot for the exec slide? Health dipped ~8% after onboarding lag. Who can pull top ticket reason codes?
Omar Enablement: I'll build the live tracker and capture enablement asks. Proposing a 20-min rehearsal Thu to assign owners.
slidebot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/northstar/ebr_v0.4  comments on slide 2 notes.
Lena CSM: Tom, add a single note: "Fallback: switch to quantized model if p95 > 300ms." Also add a one-line contingency: "play recorded GIF if streaming fails."
Tom SE: ack  adding step bullets and an offline GIF. Preloading local assets.
Grace AM: Quick risk bullets: (1) onboarding backlog, (2) SLA gap on ingest, (3) billing dispute. I'll draft a 2-line exec blurb + mitigations.
Omar Enablement: Tracker template: `Owner | Task | ETA | Priority | Status | Follow-up owner | Confidence`. Editable for owners, view-only for execs. I'll add a "Severity" tag.
Lena CSM: Timeline: slides polished Wed EOD, rehearsal Thu 10am PT, tracker live in deck before meeting, exec intro: 45s health + 90s roadmap. Flag conflicts now.
Grace AM: I have a conflict Thu morning  will record a 90s voice blurb for my exec line.
Tom SE: Tagging @eng-runtime for 1-2 bullets on perf variance to paste in slide notes.
Omar Enablement: Live tracker link: https://sheets.redwood.com/northstar-ebr-actions  populating rows and pinging owners now.
Lena CSM: Thanks team. After rehearsal we'll triage follow-ups by priority and set SLAs. Please confirm owners by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
